notes:
What's new in 1.0: data quality and photo checks
- Every survey now records when it was opened, finished (Send form) and sent, with GPS at start and finish. Nothing to do: it's automatic
- Review shows a "Data quality record": time to complete, time and distance since the last survey, and any flags for a supervisor (short survey under 15 min, night start, not finished the same day, no start GPS, under 1 min between surveys, travel over 120 km/h)
- Photo questions open the camera only. Gallery and old photos can't be attached
- Each photo is stamped with GPS, time and household, and checked against the household's location: "Verified photo", or a flag if it was taken far away or without GPS
- Try it: Household survey now asks for a photo of the homestead; Livestock health visit has an optional photo of the animal
